what_it_is:
The Xia 4.5 CT is a cortical trajectory screw utilized in the LITe (Less Invasive Technology) TLIF/PLIF procedure and allows for less tissue removal and pedicle screw fixation from a medial to lateral trajectory. The set uses tap markers for distraction of the screws or a spinous process or laminar distractor for opening the disc space.
Screw options: cannulated or non-cannulated
Polyaxial screw head
Screw diameters: 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5mm
Screw Length: 20-70mm
